Tune in to this evergreen song Main Chali from the movie Padosan (1968) starring Sunil Dutt, Mehmood and Saira Banu in the lead only on Bollywood Classics.
Movie: Padosan
Singers: Lata Mangeshkar, Asha Bhosle
Music: R. D. Burman
Lyrics: Rajendra Krishan
Cast: Sunil Dutt, Mehmood and Saira Banu
Director: Jyoti Swaroop
